items.title: ExaFlow Research Assistant
items.description: Presented findings on GPU parallelization and HPC techniques at the APS Global Physics Summit. Developing a physics-informed neural network (PINN) optimized for fluid dynamics simulations on HPC systems. Optimizing memory access patterns and GPU kernel executions with CUDA for 150% improved throughput on multi-node GPU clusters to improve performance of C++ computational fluid dynamics solver ExaFlow3D. Benchmarking GPU parallelization frameworks (OpenMP, OpenACC, Kokkos, SYCL) on Georgia Tech's PACE ICE cluster to evaluate scalability, memory bandwidth, and computational efficiency. Collaborating with a team of 12 graduate and undergraduate students to scale ExaFlow3D.

items.title: Amentum Internship
items.description: Created a chassis monitor that will fly on the Artemis III mission to collect health and status information on the Programmable Logic Controllers, network bridges, and other embedded systems every millisecond. Built networking infrastructure to securely broadcast on the NASA network with under 10 millisecond latency. Designed a dashboard to monitor the rocket during launch rehearsals with stakeholder feedback. Authored documentation so stakeholders could compile the chassis monitor object into future launch rehearsals.
